conditions.name: Releasable evidence to task
conditions.proposed_application: For the proposed use, record what the current edition can support after actual output permissions/context review, and what it cannot. Use an honest narrower reading path or no-fit conclusion where appropriate.
conditions.counterexample: A prospective US investment user is promised country-specific acquisition decision evidence from a mainly UK operating cohort simply because the report has six-to-ten contributors.
conditions.correction: Do not invent US observations or imply representative investment diligence. Check whether bounded UK/context insight still serves their stated task; otherwise narrow the promise or decline that use.

conditions.name: Interpretation or additional work
conditions.proposed_application: Define the briefing question and what existing evidence it interprets; flag requested new client facts, interviews, modelling or research as outside that service unless separately agreed.
conditions.counterexample: A consultant buys an edition briefing but asks for a new client-country vendor assessment that the edition did not study.
conditions.correction: Explain available evidence and limits; do not repackage new bespoke research as a reading-path adjustment or promise extra work under the current commission.

conditions.name: Benefit delivered or outcome achieved
conditions.proposed_application: Define the actual acknowledgement, use asset or briefing and how fulfilment would be recorded; keep estimated reach/response/impact separate and unproved.
conditions.counterexample: A partner logo is included in a report, so the model treats it as measured audience visibility or guaranteed leads.
conditions.correction: Recognise only the actually delivered placement/use/service; audience and commercial effect require their own measurement and cannot be assumed from the asset.
